Talia: Quick heads-up: tomorrow we'll open GH200-based 'gh200-highmem' dedicated pools in eu-west-2 and sao-paulo (southeast-southamerica). This is a limited pilot for latency-sensitive long-context workloads.

Talia: Key behavioral change: shared/flexible pool eviction now factors compute_class affinity — meaning requests pinned to gh200 may displace flexible jobs more aggressively. No changes to committed Dedicated reservations.

Omar: How large is the pilot capacity?

Talia: 48 cards in eu-west-2 (spread across two AZs), 6 cards in sao-paulo pilot.

Priya: Ops notes: tag added: compute_class=gh200-highmem. Fallbacks: routes can list compatible compute classes; if cross-class fallback disabled, requests will failover to regions only. Example route snippet in console:
```json
{"model":"redwood/gptx-xl","compute_class":"gh200-highmem","fallback":["a100x","mi300-compat"]}
```

Nate: SRE plan: 5% canary for 12h, then 25% for 12h if stable. Alert: on-call if eviction-rate > 0.5% for 20m.

eng-bot: Release notes published: https://intranet.redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/gh200-pilot. Rollout dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/gh200-pilot

Priya: Billing: GH200 will have an infra-hour premium for first 60 days. No per-token changes. We'll notify customers with active reservations 72h before any forced migration windows.

Omar: Customers doing long-context evals — any perf guidance?

Talia: Use kv cache hints and enable prefix caching. GH200-highmem has larger HBM and is tuned for >32k context. We'll add a short tuning guide in the docs.

Priya: Sales: add console badge and early-access sign up. Priority to customers with Dedicated commitments >2 months.

Talia: Action items: (1) Eng-runtime: verify cross-class fallbacks (Priya) (2) SRE: monitor canary metrics + eviction (Nate) (3) Sales: update console & comms (Omar) (4) Billing: flag infra-hour change and prepare customer notifications (Priya). Will post a follow-up after 48h of canary.

Nate: Runbook snippet added to announcements runbook.

Talia: Thanks team — appreciate quick reviews. :rocket:
